_about: Ethanol (1) + Furan (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of ethanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: E. Auger, C. Coquelet, A. Valtz, M. Nala, P. Naidoo, D. Ramjugernath, Equilibrium data and GC-PC SAFT predictions for furanic extraction, Fluid Phase Equilib. 430 (2016) 57-66
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 4, 5. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0094. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
